$comment: Curated half of the attribution dataset — the notices that CANNOT be derived
from package.json / node_modules, because the thing being credited is not an
npm dependency: source we adapted or vendored, and DATA served at runtime.
The derived half (npm dependencies, vendored fonts) is read from the repo by
scripts/gen-attributions.mjs — do NOT hand-add a dependency here; it would
duplicate the generated entry and go stale the moment the dep is removed.
`required: true` marks a notice that a LICENCE obliges us to display (ODbL,
provider terms), as opposed to one we show because it is right to credit.
The panel renders required notices first and the gate refuses to drop one.
Every `license` and `copyright` below is read from the upstream's own LICENSE
file, VERBATIM — never from a badge, a README claim or memory. If you cannot
establish one, say so in the note; do not invent a plausible value.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.note: Map data behind the default Carto basemap. ODbL obliges the credit wherever the tiles are shown.

sources.name: CARTO
sources.note: Default light/dark basemap styles and tiles (positron / dark-matter).

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.note: The owned-source component model and many primitive implementations; the registry is shadcn-compatible (ADR 0001).

sources.name: AI Elements
sources.note: Vendored into @elabs/components-ai and rewired onto brand-ui primitives and tokens. Apache-2.0, NOT MIT: §4 obliges us to carry the notice and to state that we modified the files.

sources.name: assistant-ui
sources.note: The message-part grouping design behind part-groups.ts, re-expressed in this library's idiom.

sources.name: Milkdown
sources.note: The @milkdown/react integration is vendored under markdown-editor/milkdown-react/ and adapted; Milkdown itself is also a runtime dependency.

sources.name: mapcn
sources.note: The MapLibre component set @elabs/components-maps was adapted from (ADR 0015).

sources.name: anyview
sources.note: The pluggable adapter-registry architecture behind the file viewer (ADR 0024).

sources.name: extend-hq/ui
sources.copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 CrowdView Inc, dba Extend; portions Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn
sources.note: The view-state seam and chrome-part inversion the viewer adopted (ADR 0026). Its LICENSE.md carries two copyright lines; both are reproduced.

sources.name: blocks.so
sources.note: The sidebar-02 / sidebar-04 / sidebar-05 copy-owned blocks, re-tokenized with Tabler icons mapped to Lucide.

sources.name: shadow-plugin
sources.note: The stacked, layered elevation-ramp technique behind the shadow tokens (ADR 0020).

sources.name: @ncdai/shimmering-text
sources.note: The ShimmeringText component, from the ncdai shadcn registry. Its TRADEMARK.md grants no right to the author's name or brand assets — the code is adopted, the branding is not.

sources.name: Liveline
sources.note: The live-axis tick-interval picker behind live-y-axis.tsx. Upstream now names that function niceTimeInterval.

sources.name: Bklit UI
sources.note: Sample datasets in the bar / composed / candlestick chart stories. Attributed to bklit-ui (MIT, the charts library) rather than the archived bklit app (CC BY-NC 4.0) — see the note in ATTRIBUTION.md.

sources.name: Radix UI Primitives (patched)
sources.note: Beyond the npm dependency below, the shipped dist of react-scroll-area and react-select is modified in patches/ — disclosed here so the change is not invisible.

sources.name: Web Interface Guidelines
sources.note: Adopted delta-only into the repo's interaction-guidelines rule. Governance, not shipped code.

sources.name: vercel-labs/agent-skills
sources.note: The composition-patterns skill behind the component-api rule's compound-component conventions. The repo declares NO licence and ships no LICENSE file — credited by link, with no licence claimed.

sources.name: subyfly/topojson
sources.note: world-countries.json, fetched at runtime by the stat-card-choropleth-01 registry block. Its LICENSE names no holder, and upstream traces the file to johan/world.geo.json, which calls its own legal status dubious — the block already carries a TODO to self-host a clean source.
